purpose: Copied original renderer and helpers, adapted only in this isolated prototype.

src/art.js: Use optional game.waterLevel for the tide animation.
Use optional item.tilt for smooth fish dodging without reversing.
Draw a seated lower body and boots for the fisherman.
Use moving water for the shared fishing-net outline.
Allow the rescued turtle to face its swimming direction.
Accept a catch-squash value animated by Phaser Tweens.
Allow a wider camera viewport without stretching actors.
Allow cyan luminous fish while retaining the original tail/blink drawing.
Allow the dedicated frontal drawing to replace the side-view player during the perspective transition.
src/game.js: Allow netShape to accept a moving water level; rendering and collision share its polygon.
src/scenery.js: Extend sky/water fills and distant shoreline to the optional wider viewport.
